name: Ambulance (108), emergency response
note: The emergency-response ambulance for accidents, trauma, cardiac events and similar: the one to call for a genuine emergency. Free, operated in most states (including Rajasthan) by an empanelled agency (historically GVK EMRI) under a government-funded model. Distinct from 102 below.

name: Ambulance (102), basic patient transport
note: A non-emergency patient-transport ambulance service, historically focused on maternity/infant transport under the National Health Mission, not the number to call for an acute emergency. Use 108 (or 112) instead for anything urgent.

name: 24-hour pharmacy, Pushkar or Ajmer

Multiple pharmacies exist in Pushkar's main bazaar per general town listings, but none could be confirmed by name/phone. Ask hotel staff on arrival, or use a hospital pharmacy (Mittal Hospital, verified above) as a fallback since hospital pharmacies commonly run longer hours.

name: Ajmer Junction railway cloakroom
addr: Outside the main entrance, near the luggage-scanning area, beside the Railway Inquiry Booth, Ajmer Junction
hours: historically reported closing ~2:00-2:30pm, CONFIRM AT COUNTER, this could not be re-verified as current
note: The commonly-quoted fee of ₹10/bag for 12 hours traces to a source dated around 2012 and is almost certainly stale, current Indian Railways cloakroom guides (2025) cite general rates in the ₹15-30/day range at other stations, but no Ajmer-specific current fee could be found this pass (indianrail.gov.in's cloak-room page returned 404, and web search quota was exhausted before an alternate route could be tried). Requires a photocopy of ID plus a valid train ticket; a hand-written deposit slip is issued. TREAT THE FEE AS UNKNOWN, confirm at the counter, do not quote ₹10 to anyone.

name: Ajmer Junction retiring rooms
hours: bookable in blocks (commonly 12hr) via IRCTC retiring-room portal or station counter with ticket + ID
note: Rate figures (Non-AC double ₹250/12hr, AC Deluxe double ₹500/12hr, AC Super Deluxe double ₹750/12hr, Dormitory non-AC ₹100/12hr, Dormitory AC ₹150/12hr) come from a third-party blog (RailMitra, dated 2026), cross-checked against a Northwest Railway rate-card PDF that is itself dated 2014 and likely stale. Neither is IRCTC's own live tariff page. Usable for a rough budget estimate, not as a quoted price, confirm on IRCTC's retiring-room booking page or at the counter.
